disableOverrides.title: Turn CORS overrides off
disableOverrides.description: When true, CORS Unblocker never changes response headers and users cannot switch it on. Blocked calls are still detected and explained.

trustedPages.title: Trusted pages
trustedPages.description: Pages whose cross-origin calls get relaxed CORS for every user, such as "localhost:3000" or "https://app.dev.example.com". Users can add their own but cannot edit or remove these.

blockEveryWebsiteMode.title: Block "Every website" mode
blockEveryWebsiteMode.description: When true, users cannot relax CORS for every website; only trusted pages and individually unblocked calls are relaxed.
